Subject: Your experience could make a difference

Hey [Name],

Would you consider being a guest speaker at the local event? You have practical experience that could really help people, especially those just starting out. You don’t need to be a polished performer—your thoughtful, honest perspective is what would make you worth hearing.

I know public speaking isn’t your favorite thing. Before committing, you could ask about a short Q&A with a host instead of a formal speech, and whether they can share the questions beforehand. I’d happily help you practice and be there to support you.

You don’t have to become someone who loves the spotlight to have something valuable to say. I think a few people would leave feeling more capable because they heard from you.

Would you be open to finding out more?

[Your Name]
question: Write a persuasive email to convince your introverted friend, who dislikes public speaking, to volunteer as a guest speaker at a local event. Use compelling arguments and address potential objections. Please be concise.
